title: $1.5M–$3M Stolen From Earl Thomas: Both Plead Guilty

lines.say: Up to three million dollars stolen, prosecutors say, from the man news reports identify as Super Bowl champion Earl Thomas. His estranged wife and her boyfriend just pleaded guilty.
lines.show: Up to $3 million stolen, prosecutors say, from the man news reports identify as Super Bowl champion Earl Thomas. His estranged wife and her boyfriend just pleaded guilty.

scene.label: STOLEN FROM EARL THOMAS|BOTH PLEADED GUILTY

lines.say: They opened accounts in his name. Her boyfriend practiced signing it.
His union payments were redirected. One check: eight hundred eighty-five thousand, four hundred nineteen dollars.
lines.show: His union payments were redirected. One check: $885,419.

lines.say: On November twelfth, both pleaded guilty to wire fraud conspiracy. Up to five years each on that count.
